specification.name: Agent Spend Control Plane PRD v3.4 Consolidated

statusDefinitions.accepted: Every clause is proved by current required artifacts at the declared release stage.
statusDefinitions.local_evidence: Direct executable local evidence exists, but this is not full AC acceptance.
statusDefinitions.partial: Related implementation exists without complete clause-by-clause executable evidence.
statusDefinitions.missing: A required implementation or executable evidence adapter is absent.
statusDefinitions.external_required: Completion depends on production-equivalent or independent external evidence.
statusDefinitions.reserved: Inactive direct-rail criterion reserved by PRD section 12.6.

ownershipOverrides.rationale: PRD section 36.1 omitted an owner for the active end-to-end purchase criterion; controlplane coordinates the cross-package proof.
PRD section 36.1 omitted an owner for the active unlisted-seller criterion; controlplane owns the Ring 2 decision boundary.
PRD section 36.1 omitted an owner for the active blocked-category criterion; controlplane owns policy enforcement.
PRD section 36.1 omitted an owner for the active failover-drain criterion; operations coordinates the unified bearer drain.
